rights_policy: Dryad datasets are released under CC0-1.0; scholarly citation is retained.

sources.title: Consumer preference data for black coffee
sources.geography: Sensory sessions at UC Davis, United States; one washed Honduras coffee
sources.time_period: Study sessions reported by the source; dataset published 2023-01-16
sources.preparation_coverage: Dataset-level drip/batch-filter black coffee; preparation does not vary
sources.roast_coverage: Dataset-level medium roast; roast does not vary
sources.sensory_coverage: Consumer liking, JAR ratings, and 17 binary CATA attributes
sources.known_limitations: The repository abstract says 3,168 rows in one sentence, but the frozen CSV contains 3,186 data rows and matches the stated 118 x 27 design.

sources.title: Acids in Coffee - A Review of Sensory Measurements and Meta-Analysis of Chemical Composition
sources.geography: 121-publication meta-analysis; geography is heterogeneous and not a single sampling frame
sources.time_period: Underlying publications reviewed April-December 2020; dataset version published 2021-07-14
sources.preparation_coverage: Source extraction labels include immersion, espresso, filter, French press, drip, cold brew, laboratory extraction, instant, and unresolved terms
sources.roast_coverage: Source semi-qualitative labels include light, medium, dark, green, roasted, steamed, and unspecified
sources.sensory_coverage: No sensory outcome rows; chemical acid concentrations only
sources.known_limitations: Not a consumer sensory dataset. Source roast labels were harmonized by the authors to three approximate classes. Wide CSVs contain trailing empty columns.

sources.title: Data for the 2024 full-immersion temperature, time, and roast sensory study
sources.geography: Not verified from an accessible dataset record
sources.preparation_coverage: Associated article reports full immersion; exact frozen data fields not inspected
sources.roast_coverage: Associated article reports two roast treatments; exact frozen data fields not inspected
sources.sensory_coverage: Associated article reports descriptive sensory analysis; exact frozen data fields not inspected
